frequency_question: How often do states formalize a successor agreement to an expiring water treaty before the expiration date?
membership_rule: Includes: Formal bilateral agreements or MoUs signed to replace an expiring water treaty. Excludes: Unilateral declarations, non-binding joint statements without specific sharing terms, or agreements signed after the expiration date.
provenance_note: 4 cases named, 6 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.5x)
coverage_note: 6 cases identified representing major transboundary water treaty negotiations.
known_gaps: Difficulty in tracking informal MoUs that may not be widely reported in international databases.
skeleton: Total instances of expiring water treaties requiring formal renewal vs. those successfully signed before the deadline.
validity_reason: Diplomatic norms regarding transboundary water management remain stable over multi-year cycles.
